title: Machine Learning for Functional Genomics
description: This course will introduce modern probabilistic machine learning methods using applications in data analysis tasks from functional genomics, where massively-parallel sequencing is used to measure the state of cells: e.g. what genes are being expressed, what regions of DNA (“chromatin”) are active (“open”) or bound by specific proteins.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Proficiency in a high level programming language Python/R/Julia.
raw_title_text: COMS W4762 Machine Learning for Functional Genomics. 3 points .
